title: The 9 Levels of Claude Code
topic: Claude Code mastery ladder: terminal -> memory -> commands -> skills -> MCP -> subagents -> hooks -> headless -> routines
notes: Backgrounds use CSS dune fallback; generated painting slots: assets/images/lvl-bg.png (slides) + lvl-bg-cover.png (cover). All mockup content is real and correct.

levels.title: Terminal
levels.def: Claude Code lives in your terminal and takes plain English
levels.body: You describe the change you want. Claude reads your files, makes the edits and runs the tests — and asks first before anything risky.

levels.title: Memory
levels.def: CLAUDE.md — a file in your repo that Claude reads at the start of every session
levels.body: You write your stack, naming and rules into CLAUDE.md once, and every session starts already knowing your project. No re-explaining.

mock.title: Claude Code
lines: > refactor the billing flow @src/billing/checkout.ts @CLAUDE.md
└ ✓ read CLAUDE.md — conventions, stack, naming
└ ✓ read src/billing/checkout.ts (214 lines)
└ ✓ read src/billing/stripe.ts (referenced import)
└ ✓ loaded 3 files · ~38.4k tokens into context

levels.title: Commands
levels.def: slash commands are shortcuts you type with a / to run a set action
levels.body: One keystroke triggers a set action — /clear wipes the chat, /compact shrinks the history, /context shows what fills the window.

rows.d: show what is filling the window

levels.title: Skills
levels.def: a skill is a saved playbook Claude loads on demand for a repeat task
levels.body: You package a repeatable workflow into a skill once, then call it by name — and Claude follows your exact steps every single time.

rows.d: topic in, 10 slides out — my system
turn a build into a lead magnet

levels.title: MCP
levels.def: MCP is the open standard that plugs Claude into your outside tools and data
levels.body: Connect servers through MCP and Claude reaches your real tools — it reads your docs, queries your database or drives your browser without leaving the terminal.

levels.title: Subagents
levels.def: a subagent is a second Claude that runs a task in its own context window
levels.body: Hand a big job to a subagent and it works on the side — a long search or refactor runs in parallel while your main thread stays clean.

levels.title: Hooks
levels.def: a hook is a script Claude runs automatically on a chosen event
levels.body: You map an event to a script in settings.json — load context when a session starts, guard risky commands, get pinged when Claude stops.

mock.title: settings.json
lines: { "event": "before a tool", "script": "guard.sh" },
] ← on this event, run this script

levels.title: Headless
levels.def: headless mode runs Claude Code from a script with no chat window
levels.body: Call claude -p inside CI or a cron job and it works with no chat open — reviewing every pull request and failing the build on a regression.

mock.title: Claude Code
lines: $ claude -p 'review the diff, fail on regressions'

levels.title: Routines
levels.def: a routine is a Claude Code job that runs on a schedule in the cloud
levels.body: Put a task on a schedule and Claude runs it on its own — triaging your inbox or checking the deploy every morning before you open your laptop.

mock.title: Claude Code
lines: ✓ Mon  ✓ Tue  ✓ Wed  ✓ Thu  ✓ Fri
it triages the inbox before you wake up
